content: [GitHub Issue #287 charlie-sre Thu Mar 08 11:00 EST 2026] CI cache always misses. Every run downloads all dependencies from scratch. This adds 3-5 minutes to every build.
Root cause identified: ci.yml uses `github.sha` in cache key, causing permanent miss. Must switch to `hashFiles('**/package-lock.json')`.
[GitHub Issue #287 bob-devops Thu Mar 08 11:30 EST 2026] Also using actions/cache@v2 which is deprecated. Final deprecation deadline was March 1, 2025. Need to upgrade.
Confirmed: two distinct issues — wrong cache key (github.sha) and deprecated cache action (v2). Both must be fixed simultaneously.
